author: ThatOneBean
body:
Hello, it's been almost a month since I first released my idea, I've decided I will do this and over the "month" I've been thinking of ways to make it better.

How Will It Work?

Well basically it will work the same as Tazz's "Staff vs Regulars" Unofficial tournament for deciding the teams. But other aspects of this will be different from it.

How Do You Get On A Team?

Well, I will be handpicking leaders (Like Tazz did) to lead one of the 8 teams for this. They are allowed to pick up to 13 members. This will give them enough players for if they need subs they will have the players for it.

Regarding Feedback And Suggestions?

If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns please contact me via Skype or Email

Contact Info:

Skype: danfromyoutube
Email: 123aviblocklag@gmail.com (Classic email xD)

Prizes?

Prizes will be decided at the end of the Tournament when I winner is declared


Map Pool?

-Rendezvous CTW
-Wahiz CTW
-The Finale CTW
-Senex CTW

-Rendezvous 3.5 DTM
-Senex Scrim
-Babylon
-Cherryland One

-SupplyTDM

Team Names:

-NorthAmerica (1)
-North America (2)
-Europe (1)
-Europe (2)
-Oceania (1)
-Asia (1)
-SouthAmerica (1)
-SouthAmerica (2)

Dates & Times?

Dates, March 12th to March 16th.
Times, Times will be announced February 29th.

Hopefully this will be a great turnout and won't fail like my Walls Tournament, but I guess it failed because no one plays walls anymore.

Regards, Dawson.
